```{r}
library("tidyverse")
library("usethis")
library("gitcreds")
library('readxl')
library("gert")
library("glue")
library("nudibranch")
library("stringr")
library("dplyr")
```


```{r upload data}
nudi_data <- read_excel(here::here("data/nudidata.xlsx"))
nudi_data

```



```{r}
# Clean the place_guess column
clean_nudi_data <- nudi_data %>%
  mutate(place_guess = case_when(
    place_guess %in% c("Ammitsa Beach, Greece", "Ammitsa") ~ "Ammitsa",
    place_guess %in% c("Pounta, South Pelion, Greece") ~ "Pounta",
    place_guess %in% c("Vlachorema, Greece", "Vlachorema", "Vlachorema, Pelion") ~ "Vlachorema",
    place_guess %in% c("Platanias Beach", "Platanias") ~ "Platanias",
    place_guess %in% c("Neraki cave, Pelion", "Neraki beach, Pelion", "Neraki Cave, Pelion", "Neraki cave", "Neraki") ~ "Neraki",
    place_guess %in% c("Liri beach, Pelion", "Liri beach", "Liri") ~ "Liri",
    place_guess %in% c("Theotokos beach, Pelion") ~ "Theotokos",
    place_guess %in% c("Mourtias beach") ~ "Mourtias",
    TRUE ~ place_guess)) # Keeps all other site names unchanged
    
  
  

#view to make sure everything is labeled correctly
table(clean_nudi_data$place_guess)

clean_nudi_data |> 
  distinct(place_guess)
```

```{r}
#
cleaned_nudi_data<- clean_nudi_data |>
  mutate(
place_guess = str_to_lower(place_guess),
place_guess = str_replace_all(place_guess, pattern = " ", replacement = "_"),
place_guess = str_trim(place_guess)
  )

print(cleaned_nudi_data$place_guess)
```
```{r}
#graph cleaned nudi data of taxon_genus_name and place_guess
ggplot(cleaned_nudi_data, aes(x = place_guess, fill = taxon_genus_name)) +
  geom_bar(position = "dodge") +
  labs(title = "Nudibranch Observations by Location and Genus",
       x = "Location",
       y = "Count of Observations",
       fill = "Genus Name") +
  theme(nudibranch_palette("hypselodoris")) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

```
